name: BBQ Salmon OR Trout
description: Salmon or trout fillets marinated in onion soup mix and Clamato juice, grilled to perfection in foil.
recipeIngredient: 2 large fillets of salmon or trout
Citrus and pepper seasoning (e.g., Club House brand)

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and clean the fillets. Place skin side down on aluminum foil.
Sprinkle the contents of the onion soup mix evenly over the fillets.
Add butter on top of the fillets.
Squeeze the juice of ½ lemon over the fillets and slice the remaining ½ for garnish.
Add citrus and pepper seasoning to taste.
Pour Clamato juice over the fillets.
Wrap the foil over the fillets, sealing the seams tightly.
Cook on a barbecue on medium-high heat on the bottom rack for 25 to 30 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

keywords: BBQ salmon, BBQ trout, grilled fish, Clamato juice marinade

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful sweet and sour chicken recipe using onion soup mix and apricot jam.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together onion soup mix, apricot jam, and Russian dressing in a bowl.
Pour the mixture over the chicken in a baking dish.
Bake at 350°F for 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, easy chicken recipe, apricot jam chicken
